acquisition.label: All-LED, 30 degree indexing
acquisition.illumination: all twelve chamber white LED dies lit simultaneously, no external source
acquisition.white_point: one fixed per-camera white point estimated from the white BMW under the twelve-LED illuminant, applied unchanged to all three vehicles
acquisition.supersedes: the externally relit 45 degree sequences, retained on disk as the illumination-limited baseline

caveats.sample: Two physical vehicles. Every count is a case-study description, not an accuracy estimate. There is no per-instance ground truth on this sequence, so no precision, recall or F1 is reported.
caveats.confound: The damage model was fine-tuned on 22 images of the damaged car and none of a comparable clean one. Its false-positive behaviour on gloss black is a property of that training set as much as of the surface.
caveats.scale: Every measurement is on 1:18 and 1:24 scale die-cast subjects. A millimetre on a model is not a millimetre on a full-size vehicle, and depth does not scale by direct multiplication.
